svg.title: SIPP and the generic A* search
svg.desc: UML class diagram: SippAgv builds a SippEnvironment per call and runs the SingleSourceSearch template on it; SippEnvironment implements the abstract SearchEnvironment for SippState; the safe-interval table stores an IntervalSet per footprint and location.

g.text: SingleSourceSearch is one A* function template; the problem is supplied by a SearchEnvironment. For CHUGG, SippAgv builds a SippEnvironment for each PlanEvents call: the state is (move or wait, time interval, goal index), and the safe-interval table is where other AGVs' motions are carved in.
